Formocortal (BAN, USAN, rINN)  FI-6341; Fluoroformylon; Formocortalum. 3-(2-Chloroethoxy)- 9α-fluoro-11β,21-dihydroxy-16α,17α-isopropylidenedioxy-20- oxopregna-3,5-diene-6-carbaldehyde 21-acetate. Формокортал C29H38ClFO8 = 569.1. CAS — 2825-60-7. ATC — S01BA12. ATC Vet — QS01BA12. Profile Formocortal is a corticosteroid that is used for its glucocorticoid activity (see p.1490) in the treatment of inflammatory eye disor- ders as eye drops and eye ointments containing 0.05%. Prolonged use of ophthalmic preparations containing corticoster- oids has caused raised intra-ocular pressure and reduced visual function.
